title: Villa Renovation
shortDescription: Complete villa transformations from concept to handover.
fullDescription: End-to-end villa renovation covering design, authority approvals, civil works, MEP, joinery, and finishing. We manage Dubai Municipality / DDA submissions, site logistics, and a single fixed programme so your home is delivered turnkey without juggling multiple contractors.

title: Full Home Renovation
shortDescription: End-to-end apartment and home renovations in 8–10 weeks.
fullDescription: Apartment and townhouse renovations planned for Dubai living — kitchens, bathrooms, flooring, painting, joinery, and electrical upgrades in a coordinated 8–10 week programme. Includes free basic 2D/3D design for confirmed projects and NOC support with your building management.

title: Kitchen Renovation
shortDescription: Custom kitchens with German & Austrian hardware.
fullDescription: Bespoke kitchens fabricated in our Dubai joinery workshop with Blum / Hafele hardware, soft-close systems, and stone or quartz worktops. From layout planning and appliance coordination to final install and snagging — with warranty options up to 10 years on cabinetry.

title: Bathroom Renovation
shortDescription: Luxury bathroom fit-outs with sanitaryware & tiling.
fullDescription: Full wet-area renovations with waterproofing membranes, premium porcelain or marble tiling, sanitaryware, vanity joinery, and LED mirror packages. Designed for Dubai humidity and long-term leak protection with documented waterproofing stages.

title: Bespoke Joinery
shortDescription: In-house joinery factory for wardrobes, cabinets & custom woodwork.
fullDescription: Custom wardrobes, wall panelling, TV units, and feature millwork produced in our 15,000 sq.ft Dubai facility. Value engineering, CNC precision, veneers and lacquer finishes — delivered and installed by our own craftsmen for consistent quality control.

title: Property Inspection
shortDescription: Independent snagging for new homes, renovated spaces, and pre-handover units — catch finishing defects and hidden issues before they become costly problems.
fullDescription: Independent property snagging and thermal / finishing audits before handover. We document defects with photo reports so developers or contractors rectify issues while still under liability — protecting your investment before keys are accepted.

title: Decorative Paints
shortDescription: Artisan finishes and specialty wall treatments.
fullDescription: Specialty wall finishes including Venetian plaster, microtexture paints, feature walls, and low-VOC decorative coatings. Colour consultation and sample boards provided so finishes match your interior scheme before full application.

title: MEP & HVAC
shortDescription: Certified mechanical, electrical, and plumbing works.
fullDescription: Licensed MEP packages covering electrical rewiring, lighting design, plumbing, AC redistribution, and exhaust — coordinated with fit-out drawings so ceilings, joinery, and wet areas are conflict-free before closing works begin.

title: Authority Approvals
shortDescription: In-house team for NOCs and municipality approvals.
fullDescription: In-house drawings and submissions for Dubai Municipality, DDA, Trakhees, and building NOCs. We prepare fit-out packages, chase comments, and keep your programme moving while approvals clear.

title: Air Quality
shortDescription: Advanced indoor air treatment targeting mold spores, dust allergens, pet dander, and odors — healthier living after every fit-out.
fullDescription: Post-renovation and occupied-space air treatment to reduce mold spores, dust, allergens, and construction odours. Ideal after fit-outs or for villas with HVAC recirculation concerns — leaving interiors healthier and handover-ready.

title: Custom Furniture
shortDescription: Made-to-measure furniture for residential and commercial spaces.
fullDescription: Made-to-measure sofas, desks, reception counters, and feature furniture built to your drawings and fabric/finish selections. Coordinated with site dimensions so pieces fit elevators, corridors, and final layouts perfectly.

title: Project Management
shortDescription: Dedicated PMs for on-time, on-budget delivery.
fullDescription: A dedicated project manager owns your timeline, procurement, subcontractors, and weekly client updates. You get one point of contact, clear milestones, and proactive risk management through to snag-free handover.

title: Marble & Stone Works
shortDescription: Premium marble, granite, and stone cladding for floors and walls.
fullDescription: Supply and install of Italian and regional marbles, granite, and stone cladding for floors, bathrooms, and feature walls. Includes templating, precision cutting, sealing, and polish for a luxury finish that lasts in Dubai conditions.

title: Tile & Flooring
shortDescription: Porcelain, hardwood, and luxury vinyl flooring installation.
fullDescription: Complete flooring packages for villas, apartments, and commercial spaces — large-format porcelain, engineered hardwood, and luxury vinyl (LVT). Includes substrate preparation, levelling, waterproofing where required, precision laying, and finishing so floors are flat, durable, and aligned with your design scheme.

title: Gypsum & False Ceiling
shortDescription: Custom gypsum ceilings with cove lighting and acoustic solutions.
fullDescription: Custom gypsum board ceilings with cove lighting, bulkheads, and acoustic treatments. Coordinated with MEP and stretch-ceiling interfaces so lighting, AC grilles, and speakers sit flush and on design.

title: Stretch Ceiling
shortDescription: Modern stretch ceiling systems with printed and translucent options.
fullDescription: Modern stretch ceiling systems — matte, gloss, translucent, and printed graphics — for feature living rooms, spas, and retail. Fast install, clean lines, and integrated LED options without heavy wet works.

title: Microcement & Terrazzo
shortDescription: Seamless microcement and terrazzo finishes for contemporary spaces.
fullDescription: Seamless microcement and terrazzo for floors, bathrooms, and feature walls. Continuous surfaces with minimal joints, custom colour matching, and sealed finishes suited to modern Dubai interiors.

title: Smart Home Automation
shortDescription: Lighting, climate, and security automation integration.
fullDescription: Smart lighting, climate, shading, and security integrated during fit-out so cabling and controllers are hidden cleanly. Works with leading platforms and is coordinated with joinery and ceilings before closing.

title: Window Glazing & Partitions
shortDescription: Glass partitions, aluminum glazing, and office partitioning systems.
fullDescription: Aluminium and glass partitions, double-glazed office fronts, and residential glazing upgrades. Acoustic options, frosted films, and door hardware matched to your commercial or villa fit-out.

title: Turnkey Contracting
shortDescription: Full civil + fit-out contracting for residential and commercial projects.
fullDescription: Single-contract delivery combining civil alterations, fit-out, joinery, MEP, and finishes. Ideal for investors and owners who want one accountable contractor from empty shell to furnished handover.

title: Office Fit-Out
shortDescription: Brand-aligned offices, clinics, and co-working spaces with partitions, joinery, and MEP.
fullDescription: Brand-aligned offices, clinics, and co-working spaces — partitions, workstations, reception joinery, meeting rooms, and MEP — typically delivered in a 4–8 week programme with authority-ready drawings.

title: Windows & Doors
shortDescription: Aluminium, timber, and glass doors and windows specified and installed as part of the fit-out.
fullDescription: Supply and install of aluminium, timber, and glass doors and windows as part of your renovation. Developer-compliant specs, acoustic and thermal options, and coordination with joinery and flooring transitions.
